shots.seen: Uncle now has grey receding hair, thick grey moustache, creased face, eyes black until a sweep hits, kurta placket with buttons and a brown wool shawl over one shoulder; window with bars fully visible.
problems: hair reads as a smooth pale cap
near sleeve is a flat slab with a hard outline
shots.fix: Rough up the hair cap with strands, soften sleeve rim light, lower the rim alpha on the near arm.

shots.seen: Aisle with magenta curtain, chain, tube lights; unchanged from v1 and softer now that clarity runs before grain.
shots.fix: Raise clarity for this shot and add crisp berth numbers and seams on the left.

problems: blurred holder behind is almost invisible
shots.fix: Add the crisp berth edge under the ticket and brighten the lower backdrop.

shots.seen: Close face with white moustache and deep creased sockets, shoulders in a dark mass.
